Blaming others feels good. It also keeps you stuck.

Kevin Trudeau says karma is simply cause and effect. Things in your life come back to you based on what you put out first.

So take responsibility for everything to the level you are capable of, and don't blame others. That's where your power to change things begins.

What would change if you stopped blaming and started owning it?
